gal-a-qikly-qikly.description: Write tests that can actually fail, by withholding the acceptance criteria from the agent that writes the code. Use when someone does not trust a suite that passes. Use when they want tests written from a specification rather than from the code. Use when they ask whether a specification is testable, or want an existing suite scored by planting faults in the code. Python modules, through the qikly tool. Also use whenever qikly or spec-driven testing is mentioned.
gal-a-qikly-qikly.author: Gal Arav

gal-a-qikly-docs.description: **What this gets you:** your coding agent stops needing to be told about qikly. Ask it for tests you can trust and it reaches for the tool on its own, and it knows the part that is hard to guess, which line of your specification is a decision the coder needs and which is a consequence to withhold.
